question: Will Anthropic’s IPO S-1 be public by 16 October 2026?
resolution_criteria:
Resolves YES if Anthropic’s Form S-1 registration statement for its proposed IPO becomes publicly accessible on the SEC’s EDGAR system by 23:59 New York time on 16 October 2026, inclusive.
A preliminary S-1 counts; final pricing and SEC approval are not required. Confidential submissions, leaked documents, and announcements or news reports without a publicly accessible S-1 on EDGAR do not count.
The IPO itself does not need to occur by the deadline. A subsequent postponement or cancellation does not reverse a qualifying YES. Otherwise, resolves NO.

# Anthropic public S-1 by 16 October 2026: research brief (information up to 10 October 2026)

Note: my page fetches failed because the proxy refused the connections. Everything below comes from search-result summaries. I left out any material dated after 10 October 2026.

## 1. Resolution source
- The deciding source is SEC EDGAR full-text and company search for an Anthropic PBC Form S-1. I could not open EDGAR directly.
- 2026-10-03: An IPO tracker said an EDGAR search that day found no public Anthropic S-1. [themesetfs](https://themesetfs.com/insights/anthropic-ipo-what-is-known-and-what-remains-unconfirmed)
- 2026-10-01: Bloomberg-based coverage said no public prospectus existed yet. [SiliconANGLE](https://siliconangle.com/2026/10/01/report-anthropic-targets-pre-thanksgiving-ipo-launch-despite-warning-of-ais-existential-risks/embed/)
- I found no report of a public S-1 on or before 2026-10-10.

## 2. Current status
- Nothing settles the question yet. Anthropic's only known filing is the confidential draft registration statement from 2026-06-01. [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/06/01/anthropic-ipo-s1-prospectus.html), [TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/06/01/anthropic-files-to-go-public/)
- A US rule matters here: companies that file confidentially must file publicly at least 15 days before the roadshow starts. If marketing begins the week of 9 November, the latest public filing date would be about 25 October. That falls after this question's 16 October deadline, so the reported timetable does not require a filing by the deadline. (This is my reading of the rule, not something a source stated.)

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-10-02: China Daily HK repeated the Bloomberg report of a mid-November listing target. [China Daily HK](https://www.chinadailyhk.com/article/640445)
- 2026-10-01: Bloomberg reported that Anthropic wants to go public as soon as mid-November, before Thanksgiving (26 November):
  - Formal marketing could start the week of 9 November, about a month later than the earlier mid-October plan.
  - The company still expects to list by year-end, but the schedule could change.
  - Anthropic has invited institutional investors to an investor day at its San Francisco headquarters on 14 October.
  - Prospective investors see $1.8T to $2T as a fair valuation.
  
  [Bloomberg Law](https://news.bgov.com/banking-law/anthropic-said-to-target-mega-ipo-before-thanksgiving-holiday), [SiliconANGLE](https://siliconangle.com/2026/10/01/report-anthropic-targets-pre-thanksgiving-ipo-launch-despite-warning-of-ais-existential-risks/embed/), [implicator.ai](https://www.implicator.ai/anthropic-could-start-ipo-roadshow-week-of-nov-9-putting-debut-before-thanksgiving/)
- 2026-09-18/19: The WSJ reported, as relayed by secondary sources, that the listing moved from October to November. The stated reason was that Anthropic wanted to show a strong third quarter first. [Digg](https://digg.com/ai/tu14otce), [cryptobriefing](https://cryptobriefing.com/anthropic-delays-ipo-to-november-amid-market-anticipation/), [hyper.ai](https://hyper.ai/en/stories/7c92cca0b743e35a5cd21c57f8cae9a9)
- 2026-09-05: Reuters reported that the IPO launch had shifted toward mid-October. The prospectus had been expected to go public as early as the following week, which did not happen. [CNBC/Reuters](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/09/05/anthropic-ipo-launch-shifts-toward-mid-october-reuters.html), [Tribune](https://tribune.com.pk/story/2627660/anthropic-delays-ipo-launch?amp=1)
- 2026-09-04: Bloomberg reported that Morgan Stanley, Goldman Sachs, JPMorgan and Citi are leading the IPO. [Forge](https://forgeglobal.com/insights/anthropic-upcoming-ipo-news/)
- Early September: Reports expected the public prospectus "after Labor Day" or "after Sept 7". That timing slipped repeatedly. [you.com](https://for.you.com/posts/anthropic-set-to-reveal-ipo-prospectus-after-september-7-07932260)

## 4. Base rates
- Expected public-filing dates for Anthropic have already slipped at least twice: from early or mid-September to late September, and then to a November marketing window.
- For large confidential-filing IPOs, the public S-1 usually comes about 15 to 21 days before the roadshow. One analysis says recent IPOs took about three to four weeks from public S-1 to pricing. [Polymarket coverage](https://www.actionnetwork.com/politics/anthropic-is-the-only-2026-ipo-polymarket-still-believes-in)
- With a 9 November roadshow, that pattern points to a public filing roughly between 19 and 25 October, after the deadline. A filing on or before 16 October would mean filing earlier than the rule requires. That does happen, but it was not what was reported.

## 5. Other forecasts
- Manifold has a market titled "Will Anthropic's IPO S-1 be public by…". It may be this exact question, but I could not open it to see the price. [Manifold](https://manifold.markets/jim/will-anthropics-ipo-s1-be-public-by)
- Polymarket has markets on whether Anthropic completes an IPO by the end of 2026. Reported odds were 89% in June, then about 78%, then about 68%, depending on the article date. [Action Network](https://www.actionnetwork.com/politics/anthropic-ipo-date-given-clear-timeframe-in-polymarket-odds), [Action Network](https://www.actionnetwork.com/politics/anthropic-is-the-only-2026-ipo-polymarket-still-believes-in)
- FutureSearch has a forecast page on Anthropic's IPO date. I did not see a value. [FutureSearch](https://futuresearch.ai/app/p/a/on-what-date-will-anthropic-complete-its-ipo-i)

## 6. Upcoming events before resolution
- 2026-10-14: Anthropic's investor day for institutional investors in San Francisco. A public flip could be timed near it, but no source said it would be.
- Mid-October: Q3 2026 results closing. The WSJ said Anthropic wanted to show a strong Q3 before marketing, which could push the public S-1 after Q3 numbers are ready to include.
- Rolling: Bloomberg, Reuters, WSJ or The Information reports on a specific public-filing date. So far, every report before 10 October points to marketing starting the week of 9 November.
- 2026-11-03: US midterm elections. These are after the deadline but affect the overall schedule.

Sources: the links listed above.
